verdict.rationale: A probe confirms llms.txt is live at HTTP 200 with structured links to agent-oriented docs (Overview, Agents, etc.), and the docs site itself is organized in machine-readable .md format (e.g. docs.edisonscientific.com/*.md pages), making it directly consumable by an agent. Missing for 10: no explicit vendor statement promoting llms.txt as an agent-facing feature, and the .md docs-fetch probe for the cookbook path returned a 404 rather than confirming full doc coverage.
